reponse: The first slice is Phase 1 — chart builder + saved views — and it's feature-complete behind the `dash_v2` flag by Dec 4, with the beta opening Wednesday Dec 9 [2][3]. Only 5 design partners get in at that point: Orbitly, Zest Grocers, and three accounts from the October trial cohort [3][10]. Other customers can't try it before general availability, targeted for late January and explicitly not committed [3]; Priya asked the team not to promise access to anyone else, with a waitlist to open in January [10] — that includes Pinecrest, who asked during their evaluation and were told no before GA [10][11].
